title: New Start-Ups
description: Start with the essentials: validate an idea, understand customers, keep records, and plan your business.
checklist: Write down the problem you want to solve.
Talk with potential customers about their current alternatives.
sourceNote: Learning videos and articles are from the original YERH resource collection.

title: Intermediate / Advanced Business
description: Strengthen operations and explore the skills needed for a growing enterprise.
checklist: Choose a measurable improvement to test.
sourceNote: Advanced videos were recovered from the original Intermediate / Advanced Business page.

title: General and Well-Being
description: Build sustainable working habits alongside your business skills.
checklist: Set realistic priorities for the week.
Leave space for breaks and time away from work.
Reach out to a trusted peer when you need support.
sourceNote: The old navigation linked this category to the general resources page. This checklist is new illustrative demo content, not a recovered course or health advice.

title: Funding
description: Explore the original funding video, planning guide, and Youth Enterprise Development Fund links.
checklist: Prepare a clear business plan and budget.
Check current eligibility and terms with the funding provider.
Compare the costs and responsibilities before making a decision.
sourceNote: Funding articles are historical resources. Confirm current terms directly with each provider.
